name: Pressing Towards The Goal
overview: The call to press towards the goal is rooted in a life transformed by faith in Christ, who lives within believers and empowers them to walk in the Spirit (Galatians 2:20; 5:25). This pursuit involves a continual renewal of the mind to discern and fulfill God's perfect will, rejecting conformity to worldly patterns (Romans 12:2). Believers are exhorted to actively work out their salvation with reverent diligence, recognizing that it is God who enables both the desire and the ability to do His good pleasure (Philippians 2:12-13). Ultimately, God will render to each according to their deeds, underscoring the importance of steadfast obedience and spiritual perseverance (Romans 2:6).
